name: Should I paint my interior doors the same color as the trim?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint my interior doors the same color as the trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to paint interior doors the same color as the trim depends on your aesthetic preference and desired visual effect. Painting doors and trim the same color, often a neutral like white, creates a cohesive and seamless look, making rooms appear larger. Painting doors a contrasting color can create a focal point or add architectural interest. Consider your wall color, flooring, and overall home style when making this design choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting doors and trim the same color offers a cohesive look; contrasting colors add architectural interest.
